desc: Dense patterns, deep penetration, and long-range performance combine for the ultimate tungsten turkey hunting load. Fiocchi’s Golden Turkey TSS brings performance head and neck above the rest. Three-inch offerings in 12-gauge, 20-gauge, 28-gauge and 410 bore deliver hard-hitting knockdown power using the finest 18 g/cc tungsten shot and most consistent patterns on the market. The Fiocchi product development team has developed a true, high-grade load proven effective against the toughest of birds. Avid turkey hunters know the Fiocchi Golden Turkey TSS difference.
